title: vendor assessment workshops
text: To provide clarity to the OEMs regarding the Vendor Assessment (VA) and Vendor Assessment Exemption (VAE) process. To guide the OEMs regarding their VA / VAE application journey and documentation requirements. To address any common queries of OEMs, related to VA / VAE applications. Workshop Format: This will be conducted as physical (in-person) session only Duration of the workshop: Approx. 3 hours FOR PROSPECTIVE OEMs DEALING IN PRODUCTS BELONGING TO: GeM WORKSHOP ON VENDOR ASSESSMENT PROCESS Government e Marketplace (GeM) plans to conduct workshops on the Vendor Assessment (VA) process. This is an initiative of GeM through which prospective OEMs can enhance their understanding to ease their journey of Vendor Assessment on GeM. The exact dates (along with time & venue details) will be shared with OEMs over emails. You are requested to check your GeM registered email ID for the same 2 weeks before the tentative workshop date. More such workshops are likely to be planned in future. Keep watching this space for further updates. THE BROAD OBJECTIVES OF THIS WORKSHOP ARE AS UNDER : TENTATIVE SCHEDULE FOR THE NEXT 4 MONTHS 24 TH APRIL 2026 WORKSHOP 1 Electrical systems & components, measuring & testing equipment, industrial components & maintenance supplies, tools, scientific & laboratory equipment & supplies, information technology, machines, pipes & fittings, safety & security, electronics, sports, packaging & storage, construction & material handling equipment, surveillance systems & ammunitions, pumps & motors, engineering items, unmanned aerial vehicle, radio & network equipment 17 TH JULY 2026 WORKSHOP 4 Agriculture & horticulture, food & beverages, textiles & textiles accessories, transportation & vehicles, oils & lubricants, cleaning equipment & supplies, metals, minerals & earth materials, oilfield & mining, educational products, animal husbandry & livestock, kits, Agritech & New Foods, health & life sciences, ODOP, social inclusion, FPO 15 TH MAY 2026 WORKSHOP 2 Construction & structural supplies, stationery, furniture, home & personal care, fire fighting equipment, papers & paper products, toys and games, bags, footwear, musical instruments 19 TH JUNE 2026 WORKSHOP 3 Chemical, medical - diagnostics, rehabilitation & training products, drugs, medicines & vaccines, medical - critical care products, medical - consumables & disposables, emerging technologies -- 1 of 1 --
